title: Lowo Ongavunyelwe Ukuhlolwa Kwamanzi
intro: Ezincwadini zemibhalo yasendulo, kukhona umuntu othakazelisayo ondaba yakhe ayiqali ngesimangaliso esimangalisayo noma isambulo esidumayo, kodwa ngesivivinyo sokholo esilula kodwa esijulile. Isizwe sasimi emphambanweni wemigwaqo, sifuna isiqondiso saphezulu sobuholi. Okwavela kwaba isivivinyo esihlakaniphile kangangokuthi sasizokwembula amakholwa eqiniso phakathi kwabo. Ungakwazi yini ukuxazulula le mfihlakalo ngezinkomba ezishiywe ngemuva?
clues: Ngivela ozalweni abantu ababeluthanda, futhi u-Allah wangikhethela injongo engcwele ababengayiqondi.
Umzimba wami wawunophawu lokuhluka abanye ababengenalo, okwangenza ngahluka phakathi kwabantu bakithi.
Lapho umfula umenyezelwa njengovivinyo, iningi laphenduka emuva—kodwa mina ngaqhubeka phambili, ngiqhutshwa ukholo oluqinile esithembisweni sika-Allah.
Ngayalwa ukuba ngingalokothi ngiphuze emanzini angavunyelwe, kodwa ithonsi elilodwa laphuma ezindebeni zami—isono esasihlupha inhliziyo yami unomphela.
U-Allah wayehlose ukuba ngihlangane nomelusi osemusha owayezoba yinganekwane ngokubulala isitha esinamandla ngelinye ilanga.
Lapho amabutho elwa, angizange ngiwa ngesandla sesitha, kodwa ngawa ngesinqumo saphezulu njengesijeziso sokungalaleli kwami ​​emfuleni.

trial.answer: Ukuhlola ibutho ngokubayala ukuba bangaphuzi emfuleni ongcwele

outcome.answer: Ngawa empini njengesijeziso sesenzo sami esisodwa sokungalaleli

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
